title: rfc signal
description: Documents awaiting approval in a GitHub repo (providers.rfc: repo, dir, file_prefix, status_label, pending_text), read with gh every 10 min. GET /api/signals/rfc, polled every 10 min; 404 unless providers.rfc.enabled (opt-in, personal workflow); null until the first fetch. SENSITIVE (document names).

pending.description: Documents (among the newest 25 matching files) whose status row contains pending_text.

id.description: The number after '<prefix>YYYYMMDD-' in the file name, else the name.

user_action.description: The status also contains providers.rfc.user_action_text (waiting on you).

at.description: When it was checked. Unix time in seconds (float).
